title: Match Mystery
description: Match Mystery is a match-3 puzzle game. It has an endless level of a twist challenging game. It has stunning graphics, fantastic gameplay and an impressive storyline. Match Mystery is a hours of fun and brain-teasing game for all ages!
instructions: Desktop Use the right click button of the mouse to match 3 or more elements Mobile Click and drag to match 3 or more elements Controls and Indicators The scores and levels are shown in the upper middle of the screen
